basic_details.job_title: IIM Mumbai Manager Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

age_limit.details: Manager (Campus Facility Services): Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation applicable for Ex-Servicemen: As per Government of India norms, PwBD: As per Government of India norms, Deputation/Departmental candidates: No age bar.

qualification.education_qualification: Master’s Degree in any discipline with Diploma/Degree OR B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Environmental Engineering
qualification.details: Manager (Campus Facility Services): Master’s Degree in any discipline with not less than 55% marks, together with a full-time Diploma or Degree in Facility Management, Hotel Management or Environmental Health / Public Health OR B.E. / B.Tech in Civil or Environmental Engineering, or equivalent, with not less than 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. Nine (09) years’ relevant experience after the qualifying degree, of which three (03) years in Pay Level 8, or one (01) year in Pay Level 9, or equivalent.

salary_details.details: Pay Scale: Pay Level 11 (67700 - 208700) Components: Basic Pay, Dearness allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, Dearness allowance on Transport allowance

selection_process: Scrutiny/Screening of Applications Written test and/or skill test and/or interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Mumbai Manager (Campus Facility Services) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Mumbai to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Manager (Campus Facility Services) recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the Indian Institute of Management Mumbai (IIM Mumbai) for filling vacant positions in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced for Manager (Campus Facility Services)?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been advertised under the official notification Admn/Rectt/2026/30(01) issued by IIM Mumbai.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can start submitting their online applications starting from 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for successful online submission and fee payment is 8 October 2026. Make sure to complete the process before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for Manager (Campus Facility Services)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s Degree in any discipline with Diploma/Degree in Facility Management/Hotel Management/Environmental Health/Public Health OR B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Environmental Engineering.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a lucrative remuneration as per Pay Level 11 (67700 - 208700) along with other admissible allowances like DA, HRA, and Transport Allowance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General and other unreserved category candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application processing fee of Rs. 590/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for SC, ST, PwBD, and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, Women, and Internal Candidates categories are exempted from paying the application fee (Rs. 0).

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Manager (Campus Facility Services) post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website of IIM Mumbai at www.iimmumbai.ac.in and filling out the application form with all required documents.
